title: Against the Darkness: Modifier Pool, Best Sockets and Trade Search in 0.5.4
summary: Against the Darkness is a Unique Time-Lost Diamond in Path of Exile 2 0.5.4 that rolls two random modifiers: one affecting Small Passive Skills in Radius and one affecting Notable Passive Skills in Radius. This guide covers the modifier classification, the Placement Matrix for picking the best socket, why the same modifier scores differently per socket, how to preview in the passive tree, and how to trade-search two explicit mods at once.
description: Path of Exile 2 Against the Darkness guide 0.5.4: unique Time-Lost Diamond with two random radius modifiers, modifier pool, Small vs Notable targeting, best socket placement matrix, and trade search.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Path of Exile 2 Against the Darkness unique Time-Lost Diamond tooltip showing two random radius modifiers and a Medium Radius

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Against the Darkness is a Unique Time-Lost Diamond with Limited to 1 and a Medium Radius. It randomly generates with two modifiers: one 'Small Passive Skills in Radius also grant...' line and one 'Notable Passive Skills in Radius also grant...' line, drawn from a pool of about twenty. It drops from Zarokh, the Temporal in the Trial of the Sekhemas when a run uses The Desperate Alliance relic, and it cannot be created with a Chance Orb. The same modifier scores differently depending on which nodes sit inside your chosen socket's Radius.
calloutDetail: One roll always targets Small passives, the other always targets Notables; they are independent.
Radius is Medium in 0.5.4 (it was Large before 0.2.0).
Buy for a specific socket: the value depends entirely on which allocated nodes the Radius covers.

answers.label: Use for
text: Attribute stacking, defensive layers (life/resist/ailment duration), Spirit, or extra damage types on builds that already path through a jewel socket.

answers.label: Check first
text: Preview the socket's Radius in the passive tree and count allocated Small and Notable nodes before buying.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Assuming the tooltip value equals in-game value, chancing it, or placing it in a Sinister Socket.

sections.title: Where Against the Darkness sits in the jewel family
intro: Against the Darkness is one of the Diamond-base unique jewels. It shares the Time-Lost Radius system with the Sekhemas Time-Lost jewels but is a fixed unique with a random two-modifier roll.

members.title: Time-Lost Ruby / Emerald / Sapphire
body: Roll random-affix-style bonuses on nodes in Radius, biased by base color.
Different from Against the Darkness, which is a unique with a fixed two-modifier structure.

members.title: Against the Darkness
body: Unique Time-Lost Diamond; one Small-targeted and one Notable-targeted random modifier.

members.title: From Nothing / Controlled Metamorphosis / The Adorned / Megalomaniac
body: Each Diamond unique uses a different mechanic (remote keystone, ring radius, magic-jewel amp, random notables).
They are alternatives, not the same jewel.

sections.title: Overview: how Against the Darkness works
paragraphs: Against the Darkness is unique because every copy is different. When socketed, it randomly generates two modifiers: one 'Small Passive Skills in Radius also grant X' line and one 'Notable Passive Skills in Radius also grant Y' line, each drawn from a pool of roughly twenty possibilities grouped into Attributes, Maximum Life/Mana, Defences (ailment duration), Resistance, Damage (extra damage types), Spirit (skill-specific), Notable bonuses, and Small-passive bonuses.

The Small line only affects Small Passive nodes inside the Medium Radius; the Notable line only affects Notable nodes inside that Radius. By default these bonuses apply to nodes you have allocated. One rare modifier, 'Grants all bonuses of Unallocated Small Passive Skills in Radius', extends the Small bonuses to unallocated nodes too - that is the exception, not the rule.

The same modifier scores differently in different sockets because the Radius covers a different set of nodes. A '+8 to Maximum Life' line is worth more next to a dense cluster of allocated Small life nodes than next to a sparse area. This is why you must pick the socket for the roll, not the roll for a socket you already own.

Against the Darkness is not a normal Time-Lost jewel and not a Timeless jewel. It is a unique on the Time-Lost Diamond base, so it uses the Radius system but with a fixed unique two-modifier structure rather than random-affix-style rolls or Seed-driven conquest. It cannot be created with a Chance Orb and it does not go into a Sinister Socket.

Current versus legacy: in 0.2.0 the Radius changed from Large to Medium, the attribute modifiers on Notables dropped from 2-4% to 2-3%, and the Small life/mana lines changed from '1% increased Maximum Life/Mana' to flat '+8 to Maximum Life/Mana'. Existing pre-0.2.0 copies keep their old values and can even be made worse by a Divine Orb. Always check which generation you are buying.
bullets: Two independent rolls: one Small-targeted, one Notable-targeted.
Bonus applies to allocated nodes in the Medium Radius (one roll covers unallocated).
Same modifier value depends on the socket's node coverage.
Unique Time-Lost Diamond: not chanceable, not Sinister-compatible.
Legacy (pre-0.2.0) copies are Large Radius and use older values.

sections.title: Which modifiers and nodes are valid
note: Against the Darkness modifiers are scoped to Small or Notable nodes inside the Radius. Nodes outside the Radius, and Sinister Sockets, are not valid targets.

steps.label: Identify the jewel and read both rolls
body: Identify Against the Darkness to reveal the Small-targeted and Notable-targeted modifiers and their values.

steps.label: Pick the socket for the rolls
body: Open the passive tree and hover candidate sockets; the Medium Radius circle shows which Small and Notable nodes are covered.

steps.label: Allocate the covered nodes
body: For the bonuses to count, allocate the Small and Notable nodes inside the Radius (except the special unallocated-bonus roll).

steps.label: Socket and verify on the character sheet
body: Right-click the jewel into the allocated socket, then compare the character sheet before and after to confirm the gains.

steps.label: Trade-search two mods
body: On the trade site set Item Category Jewel, Rarity Unique, Name 'Against the Darkness', then read each listing's two rolls; the official site cannot filter both mods at once, so verify per listing.

before: Character sheet shows only the base values of the nodes you allocated.
after: After socketing, every allocated Small/Notable node inside the Medium Radius also grants the jewel's rolled bonuses.
compare.note: Confirm the gain by comparing the character sheet; a strong tooltip with no allocated nodes in Radius gives zero in-game value.

rows.scenario: Socket near an attribute cluster (Str/Dex/Int nodes)
rows.benefit: Notable attribute roll covers several allocated attribute nodes; Small roll adds life/mana
rows.risk: Low if on the natural path
rows.recommendation: Best socket for attribute-stacking; buy a roll with (2-3)% Attributes + a defensive Small.

rows.scenario: Socket near a life / energy-shield wheel
rows.benefit: Small '+8 Life' or '+8 Mana' covers many Small nodes; Notable Spirit or Res helps
rows.recommendation: Strong for defence/min-max; pair a life Small roll with a resistance or Spirit Notable.

rows.benefit: Small +(2-4)% elemental res covers resistance Small nodes
rows.recommendation: Good when you lack resist suffixes; combine with an attribute or Spirit Notable.
Skip unless the roll is exceptional; the detour points usually buy more elsewhere.

sections.title: Build usage
intro: Against the Darkness pays off when a socket on your path covers nodes that match its two rolls. The personas below show the main ways to use it.

builds.title: Attribute stacking
builds.description: Attribute-stacking builds (Astramentis, Hand of Wisdom and Action) want the Notable (2-3)% Str/Dex/Int roll over a dense attribute cluster.

builds.title: Defensive layers
builds.description: A '+8 Life' Small roll plus a resistance or ailment-duration roll adds a layered defensive bonus on life/ES wheels.

builds.title: Min-max Spirit and damage
builds.description: The +(8-12) Spirit Notable roll and 'Gain X% of Damage as Extra Y' rolls are strong on caster and damage-focused trees.

builds.title: Hybrid attribute + defence
builds.description: Pair an attribute Notable with a life/mana Small roll for a balanced boost without a second socket.

sections.title: Alternatives
paragraphs: If you need a remote Keystone rather than radius bonuses, From Nothing is the alternative; if you want ring-shaped remote allocation, Controlled Metamorphosis fits; if you stack corrupted Magic jewels, The Adorned is the amplifier; if you want Random Notables, Megalomaniac does that.

A basic Time-Lost jewel (Ruby/Emerald/Sapphire) gives random-affix radius bonuses more cheaply than Against the Darkness but without the unique's curated Small/Notable split and without the高价 of a perfect roll.
For pure attribute needs, a Rare jewel or gear suffixes may be cheaper than hunting a perfect Against the Darkness roll.
bullets: From Nothing / Controlled Metamorphosis for remote allocation.
The Adorned for corrupted Magic jewels; Megalomaniac for Notables.
Basic Time-Lost or Rare jewels for cheaper radius bonuses.

sections.title: Valuation: use, sell, or hold
marketNote: Value is driven by the two rolls and how many allocated nodes your chosen socket covers. The official trade site cannot filter both mods simultaneously, so price by reading each listing.

use.condition: Your socket's Radius covers many allocated nodes matching the rolls
use.first: Equip the copy whose rolls match your tree's densest nodes
use.risk: Occupies one socket; wrong socket wastes the roll
text: Use when the covered nodes make the roll clearly better than a Rare jewel in the same socket.

sell.condition: You found a roll that does not fit your tree
sell.first: List by both rolls; price attribute + defence combos at a premium
sell.risk: Liquid but sensitive to meta demand for specific rolls
text: Sell on trade; describe both modifiers clearly because the site cannot filter them together.

hold.condition: You found a high double roll (e.g. Attributes + Spirit/defence)
hold.first: Keep it; perfect rolls retain value across leagues
text: Hold a strong double roll; it is a long-term asset for attribute and caster builds.

rows.loss: Rolls cover few or no allocated nodes on your tree
rows.recommendation: Preview the socket's Radius before buying; the roll is only worth its node coverage.

rows.loss: Paid unique price for Rare-jewel-level value
rows.recommendation: Prefer one strong roll over two weak ones unless both match your nodes.

rows.scenario: Divine Orb on an old copy
rows.loss: Can make a pre-0.2.0 copy worse
rows.recommendation: Do not Divine legacy copies expecting improvement; values can drop.

rows.scenario: Detour points to reach a socket
rows.loss: Passive points that could buy a notable
rows.recommendation: Only take a far socket for an exceptional roll.

entries.question: Why does the same modifier give me less than it gives my friend?
summary: A player compared an identical Against the Darkness roll with a friend and saw different in-game values.
editorialAnalysis: The roll is identical, but each socket's Medium Radius covers a different set of allocated nodes. The bonus is applied per covered node, so coverage, not the roll number, drives the difference.
officialAnswer: The same modifier scores differently because the Radius covers different nodes; pick the socket for the roll.

entries.question: Tooltip looks strong but my stats did not change after socketing
summary: A player socketed Against the Darkness, saw a strong tooltip, but the character sheet was unchanged.
editorialAnalysis: The Small and Notable bonuses apply only to nodes allocated inside the Radius. If those nodes are unallocated (and you lack the special unallocated-bonus roll), the jewel grants nothing in-game.
officialAnswer: Allocate the Small and Notable nodes inside the Radius, then re-check the character sheet.

entries.question: How do I search for a 3% Attribute + Defence roll?
summary: A player asked how to filter two specific modifiers on the trade site.
editorialAnalysis: The official trade site does not filter both Against the Darkness modifiers at once. Set Category Jewel, Rarity Unique, Name 'Against the Darkness', then read each listing's two rolls manually or use a third-party tool.
officialAnswer: Search by name and verify both rolls per listing; there is no combined two-mod filter yet.

entries.question: Can Against the Darkness share an area with From Nothing?
summary: A player asked whether the two unique Diamonds can overlap effects in one region.
editorialAnalysis: They are separate unique jewels in separate sockets. Each has its own Radius and mechanic; they do not conflict but also do not combine into one roll. Both are Limited to 1 individually.
officialAnswer: They can coexist in different sockets but use independent Radii and rules.

problems.symptom: Tooltip is strong but character sheet did not change
directAnswer: The Small/Notable bonuses apply only to allocated nodes inside the Radius. Allocate those nodes, or the roll does nothing in-game.
checks: Preview the Radius, allocate the covered Small and Notable nodes, then compare the character sheet.

problems.symptom: Same roll weaker than a friend's
directAnswer: Different sockets cover different nodes. The roll number is identical; node coverage differs.
checks: Compare the two sockets' Radii and count allocated nodes inside each.

directAnswer: Against the Darkness is not in the Chance Orb unique pool; it drops from Zarokh with The Desperate Alliance relic.
checks: Farm the Trial of the Sekhemas or buy a specific roll on trade.

problems.symptom: Divine Orb made my copy worse
directAnswer: A Divine Orb can reroll the variable values and may lower them, especially on pre-0.2.0 copies.
checks: Avoid Divining legacy copies unless you accept the downside.
